review_locator: PMCID:PMC4076735, Regulation of immune cell responses by semaphorins and their receptors; PMCID:PMC6018527, The Role of Semaphorin 4D in Bone Remodeling and Cancer Metastasis
primary_title: Identification of CD72 as a lymphocyte receptor for the class IV semaphorin CD100: a novel mechanism for regulating B cell signaling
decision_basis: The semaphorin reviews cite the primary receptor-identification study showing CD72 is a lymphocyte receptor for SEMA4D/CD100 and that engagement relieves CD72 inhibitory signaling to enhance B-cell responses.
limitations_preserved: Preserve low-affinity CD72 and lymphocyte/B-cell context; do not infer reverse SEMA4D signaling or SCI.
